name: button-group
title: Button Group
description: Buttons, fields and printed cells joined into one row (or column) that share their seams: the edge two neighbors have in common is drawn once, by the one before, or by a pencil separator you put between them.

a11y: The group is role=group: give it an aria-label when the buttons alone do not say what they belong to. It adds no keyboard behavior of its own; Tab visits each control in order (use ToggleGroup for one tab stop with arrow keys).
A separator between buttons is decorative (role=none); the buttons keep their own names and states.
A focused child is lifted above its neighbors and keeps its whole blue felt ring; in Windows high contrast the drawing is replaced by each control's real border.
ButtonGroupText is plain text: give an input it labels a real label (use asChild with <label htmlFor>) or an aria-label.
